name: A flare-up
prompt: The fryer flares. A sheet of flame climbs the back of the hood.

choices.text: Get everyone out and pull the extinguisher

outcome.told: The extinguisher leaves powder on everything. The owner closes for the rest of the day and sends everyone home.

choices.text: Shut off the gas and smother it with a lid

outcome.told: You get the lid on and the gas off. The hood is black, but the diner stays open.

failure.told: The flame catches your sleeve before the lid goes on. The owner wraps your arm and sends you home.
